text: First feature scope required before intent can enter Design.
Accepted home-page scope: latest stable Next.js, Tailwind v4, Drizzle tooling, title-only page with no DB dependency.

User requested all feature specifications under intent/<feature-slug>/. Moved intent/intent.md, spec.md, plan.md to intent/home-page/intent.md, spec.md, plan.md respectively. Updated active graph/work item without resetting turn budget; historical approval paths remain as originally recorded.
Independent code review approved: seven regression tests, lint and typecheck passed; isolated mutation proved approval rejection covered. Browser/build evidence inspected.

Security clear for static title-only increment. Production audit0;4moderate dev-only DrizzleKit/esbuild advisories documented; no esbuild serving API started. Reassess before activating affected tooling or release.

Home-page implementation complete with all four acceptance commands passing, independent code approval and security clear. Loop stopped at its configured six-turn cap after security (phase review); budget was not extended. Workflow implementation remains in_review for human merge approval; release not started.

Rafael explicitly authorized merge to main in chat. Fast-forwarded codex/home-page into local main at 9d87b10; implementation gate closed by merge-home-page-001. No release authorized and no Git remote configured.
Accepted pnpm-migration intent: pinned stable pnpm, generated lockfile, consistent current setup and acceptance commands; preserve app dependency versions, UI and historical audit records.
Designed pnpm migration around official stable 10.33.0, compatible with Node.js 22/24; preserve direct versions, import lockfile, and explicitly review dependency scripts.

PnPM migration completed six-turn loop as solved: pinned pnpm 10.33.0, preserved direct dependencies and imported integrity data, clean/repeat frozen install and app/browser checks passed, independent security/code reviews approved. Graph awaits new human CEO merge approval; prior home-page approval is not reused. Known development esbuild advisory and legacy plan-checker attribution limitation remain documented in review evidence.

Rafael explicitly authorized merge to main in chat. Fast-forwarded codex/pnpm-migration into local main at 638c26b; implementation gate closed by merge-pnpm-migration-001. Production release remains unauthorized.

Accepted authenticated-access intent after owner selected Google sign-in; any verified Google account proposed as eligible; no invitation system. Prior pnpm loop/graph preserved in archive/pnpm-migration-001 before selecting new work item.

Intent-turn acceptance commands all exited zero: Python workflow tests, pnpm lint, typecheck and production build. Clean frozen install succeeded on Node 24.15.0/pnpm 10.33.0. This verifies unchanged baseline only; authentication implementation remains pending.

Independent reviewer approved Google authentication spec using exact stable Better Auth 1.7.27 with one-hour nonrefreshing stateless encrypted sessions, default server protection, exact auth exceptions and no database. Runtime cookie and provider-flow checks required; live Google consent check requires external credentials.

Independent plan review approved the five-slice authenticated-access build plan: failing HTTP baseline, stable auth dependency, default server boundary, real mocked-provider OAuth/session/logout tests, and browser evidence. Human merge/release remain separate.

Approved narrow spec/plan amendment for Better Auth unconditional bun:sqlite type import: exact dev @types/bun1.4.5 and conditional explicit ambient discovery, retaining strict full checking and no Bun runtime or DB.

Superseding amendment: full @types/bun globals conflict with Next; approved exact direct dev bun-types1.4.5 and explicit node/react/react-dom/bun-types/sqlite types only. Official narrow declaration strict compiler prototype passed; full typecheck/build still required. Prior amendment001 retained as history, superseded by002.

User replaced any-Google eligibility with server-code Gmail allowlist of four confirmed accounts. PM accepted same-feature intent amendment; require verified Gmail, exact trim/lower matching, empty denyall, pre-issuance and per-request enforcement, no signup/admin UI/roles.
